name: xiv-datamine-polyfill-e2e-test
description: End-to-end verification that the xiv-datamine-polyfill vite plugin embeds in a real consumer build: target code importing two generated sheets, the vite config that hooks the plugin up, and the specs that judge the built artifact's data and composition, offline and live.
author: Tanimodori

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run test:offline && npm run build-only
scripts.test: npm run test:offline && npm run test:online
scripts.test:online: cross-env XIV_LIVE=1 vite build && cross-env XIV_LIVE=1 vitest run test/online.spec.ts
